info.title: Synod development API
info.description: Development API for cluster admission, lifecycle operations, inspection, and node enrollment. Accepted operations execute through the provisioning worker. Version values are development candidates.

202.description: Accepted; the operation can remain pending without an executable plan

503.description: Metadata unavailable or commit outcome unknown; retry with the same key and body

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after one second.

get.description: Read one bounded page of installation clusters. Order by created_at descending, then id descending. The cursor keeps that order but does not create a snapshot across requests. Refresh the first page to see newer clusters. Default reads exclude completed deletion tombstones and include deletion in progress. Reject unknown or repeated query parameters. This read returns stored state; updated_at does not prove current database health.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Omit it to use 50. Reject empty, repeated, or nondecimal values.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation from next_cursor. Omit it for the first page. Bind it to the same installation and include_deleted value.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Include completed deletion tombstones. Only true and false are accepted.

200.description: One page. items is empty when no clusters match. next_cursor is empty at the end.

400.description: Invalid query or cursor. Unknown, repeated, empty, or malformed parameters are refused.

delete.description: Delete runtime access and processes while retaining data. First request a delete plan. Confirm its token, expected revision, and retain disposition. Admission revalidates the actor, target, expiry, revision, and retained volume set. Exact accepted retries resolve before expiry or deleted state checks.

get.description: List the members a cluster still has, oldest first. Each member names its role, its state, the node of its live reservation, and the client address that node declares.

post.description: Request start through the durable lifecycle operation. Supply an empty JSON object.
Request stop through the durable lifecycle operation. Supply an empty JSON object.

Preview retained-data deletion, Redis replica removal, or PostgreSQL setup recovery. The preview binds the actor, target, and revision for five minutes. Recovery names the existing member, instance resource, and retained volume. The agent checks live failure before it removes anything.

409.description: Active work or pending volume purge prevents the preview.

422.description: The engine or topology does not support setup recovery.

get.description: Read direct standalone connection metadata without passwords. Only live reservations and a declared client address can publish an endpoint. Current database traffic uses TLS mode disabled. This route does not probe reachability.
Read the newest credential metadata for each stored purpose. This route returns no password, ciphertext, wrapping key identity, or credential URL.

post.description: Explicitly reveal one stored credential. Administrator authorization and browser origin checks apply. The controller applies a dedicated limit of one request per second with a burst of five. Every successful authorization commits credential.reveal.accepted audit before decryption. This synchronous read creates no host operation or desired-state change. Success and failure use Cache-Control: no-store. No secret-bearing GET or HEAD is supported. Do not retry this POST automatically. No idempotency key or revision header is required.

200.description: Explicit credential access. Authorization was committed to audit before decryption. The audit does not prove delivery to this client.

put.description: Declare placement and client address policy for an enrolled node. Requires administrator access. Use revision zero for a node with no policy. Later updates must name the current policy revision. No host operation is created.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Exactly one nonnegative policy revision, with optional double quotes. Zero creates the first policy.

200.description: The placement policy was stored with its new revision.

post.description: Confirm a recovery preview for the existing standalone PostgreSQL member. Retain all data and credentials. Run guarded setup recovery, stop, start with initialization disabled, and authenticated application readiness. Acceptance does not prove completion. Retry the same key, revision, and confirmation after a lost reply.

422.description: The engine or topology does not support setup recovery.

get.description: Read the installation ID and the current recovery generation. An agent configuration needs both. The recovery generation can change after controller recovery. Read it when you write a new agent configuration. Before a controller runner records a generation, the API returns 503 with code recovery_generation_unavailable.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after one second.

503.description: No recovery generation is recorded, or the metadata service is unavailable.

enrollmentBearer.description: A scoped, one-use enrollment token. Generate 32 random bytes and encode them as canonical unpadded base64url.

adminSession.name: __Host-synod_session
adminSession.description: An authenticated administrator session. Unsafe requests must supply a matching Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin.

maxmemory_bytes.description: Zero or omitted uses the server resource profile. A positive value must fit within 75 percent of the Redis container memory limit. Planning rejects a value that exceeds that limit.
Zero or omitted uses the server resource profile. A positive value must fit within 75 percent of the Redis container memory limit. Planning rejects a value that exceeds that limit.

retry_of.description: The prior failed or cancelled replica-add operation. Absent for an initial operation.

csr_der.description: DER Ed25519 CSR. Retain these exact bytes and the local private key through retries.

EmptyAction.description: An empty JSON object is required.

retained_volumes.description: All non-purged volume IDs in stable order. An empty set is an empty array.

downtime.description: The expected loss of database access and the retained data disposition.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry. Plans expire five minutes after creation.

host.description: The declared canonical unicast IPv4 or IPv6 address. Use brackets around IPv6 when constructing host:port.

tls_mode.description: disabled sends plaintext. This is not the management API TLS setting.

EndpointInspection.description: Reserved addresses and stored lifecycle observations. This is not a live health probe. Stopped clusters retain connection metadata. A cluster reports the endpoint of its primary. Missing or ambiguous metadata produces an empty endpoints array and an unavailable_reason.

credentials.description: The newest stored version for each purpose, in stable purpose order. Empty before intent is recorded. No application credential is invented for PostgreSQL.

password.description: The selected plaintext password. Returned only by explicit audited reveal. Protect this output.

client_address.description: Optional canonical unicast IPv4 or IPv6 literal. Private LAN addresses are valid. Refuse loopback, link-local, multicast, unspecified, mapped, zone-bearing, and noncanonical addresses. Empty or omitted keeps the node eligible but endpoint discovery reports client_address_required. This is declared operator intent, not an address inferred from a control connection.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this installation and deletion filter. An empty string means the page has no continuation.

plan_token.description: The token from the action preview for this actor, cluster, and revision.

ActionConfirmation.description: Confirm the reviewed action. Retain the named data volumes.

node_id.description: The node that runs the member's live reservation. Absent without a live reservation.

address.description: The client address that the member's node declares. Absent when the node declares none.

ActionIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ActionIdempotencyKey.description: Supply exactly one header. Retain the same value and semantic input for retries. A changed request returns idempotency_conflict.

ActionRevision.name: If-Match
ActionRevision.description: Supply exactly one positive desired revision, with optional double quotes. Lists and weak ETags are refused. Exact accepted retries use the original revision.

BrowserOrigin.name: Origin
BrowserOrigin.description: For a session request, this must equal the configured public origin unless Sec-Fetch-Site is same-origin. Bearer requests do not require an origin proof.

BrowserFetchSite.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
BrowserFetchSite.description: The value same-origin proves the origin of a session request. Otherwise a matching Origin is required.

ActionAdmission.description: The action was admitted durably. This is not proof that execution has finished. An exact retry returns the original operation.

ActionBadRequest.description: Invalid request. This includes malformed input and an invalid, expired, or mismatched action plan.

ActionUnauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the credential is invalid.

ActionForbidden.description: Administrator access or browser origin proof is missing.

ActionNotFound.description: The cluster does not exist or has been deleted. An exact accepted retry remains available.

ActionConflict.description: An active operation or pending purge prevents the action. Changed idempotency input or a changed retained volume set also conflicts.

ActionRevisionConflict.description: revision_conflict: the desired revision no longer matches If-Match.

ActionInternalError.description: An internal error prevented the request.

ActionUnavailable.description: Metadata is unavailable or the commit outcome is unknown. Retry an action with the same key, revision, and body. A preview can be requested again.

ConnectionBadRequest.description: Invalid cluster ID, purpose, or request body. Reveal requires exactly an empty JSON object.

ConnectionNotFound.description: The cluster is absent or deleted, or the selected credential purpose has not been recorded.

ConnectionUnavailable.description: Metadata, audit commit, or credential decryption is unavailable. No plaintext is returned. An uncertain audit commit can exist without a delivered credential.

NodePolicyBadRequest.description: Invalid node ID, policy, or revision header. Supply one nonnegative If-Match revision.

NodePolicyNotFound.description: The node has not been enrolled in this installation.

NodePolicyUnsupported.description: An engine and version in the policy is not served by this controller.
